title: A valuation ring is a normal domain
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring that is a valuation ring: $A$ is a domain with fraction field $K$, and for every $x\in K^\times$ either $x\in A$ or $x^{-1}\in A$. Then $A$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], i.e. every element of $K$ integral over $A$ belongs to $A$.
